O017-L10N-ID-LO-U01-01-DESCRIPTION: distinguish definitions, assumptions, claims, illustrations, and conclusions in mathematical text;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U01-02-DESCRIPTION: turn phrases such as *clearly* or *by an exchange argument* into explicit proof obligations;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U01-03-DESCRIPTION: reconstruct omitted steps without illegitimately strengthening the claim;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U01-04-DESCRIPTION: test the role of assumptions using examples and counterexamples;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U01-05-DESCRIPTION: use computation as diagnostic empirical evidence, not as a substitute for proof; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U01-06-DESCRIPTION: record sources, interpretive decisions, and uncertainty in an auditable reading memo.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-01-DESCRIPTION: turn a mathematical claim into a bounded, repeatable search question;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-02-DESCRIPTION: distinguish search tools, metadata records, full texts, specific editions or versions, and correction records;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-03-DESCRIPTION: assess a source's authority for a particular question, rather than relying only on reputation or search-result order;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-04-DESCRIPTION: distinguish persistent identifiers for a work in general from identifiers for a particular version;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-05-DESCRIPTION: draw citation chains as directed graphs with typed relationships;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-06-DESCRIPTION: separate evidence that a source states a claim from proof that the claim is true; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U02-07-DESCRIPTION: record uncertainty without filling missing data with guesses.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-01-DESCRIPTION: freeze the claim to be reconstructed without silently adding or removing hypotheses;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-02-DESCRIPTION: expand the quantifiers, domains, and definitions that determine the proof target;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-03-DESCRIPTION: turn compressed parts of a proof into obligations with clear inputs and outputs;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-04-DESCRIPTION: draw dependency graphs between targets, lemmas, definitions, and hypotheses;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-05-DESCRIPTION: select a lemma by its mathematical contract and check every hypothesis in the current context;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-06-DESCRIPTION: connect forward planning from the hypotheses with backward planning from the conclusion;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-07-DESCRIPTION: write a minimally sufficient reconstruction—complete enough to audit without turning one step into a new textbook; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U03-08-DESCRIPTION: distinguish closed gaps, gaps conditional on a reference, and gaps that remain unresolved.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-01-DESCRIPTION: distinguish **citation**, **evidence provenance**, and **computational provenance** without substituting one for another;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-02-DESCRIPTION: record works, versions, copies, and internal locations as distinct but connected objects;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-03-DESCRIPTION: link a normalized claim to a locator precise enough for another reader to find the wording actually checked;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-04-DESCRIPTION: preserve the basis for accepting, rejecting, or restricting a mathematical claim, not merely its bibliography;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-05-DESCRIPTION: record corrections as relationships between versions without overwriting or deleting the old source's historical state;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-06-DESCRIPTION: write structured uncertainty records and refuse to fill missing metadata with guesses;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-07-DESCRIPTION: design a source notebook that can be updated, reviewed, and exported without losing its decision trail; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U04-08-DESCRIPTION: assemble a claim dossier combining citation, provenance, mathematical audit, and limits on the conclusion.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-01-DESCRIPTION: establish the audience, prerequisites, purpose, and scope of an exposition before choosing its level of detail;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-02-DESCRIPTION: organize definitions, theorems, proofs, examples, and counterexamples as components with distinct functions;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-03-DESCRIPTION: use typed notation, introduced before use and consistent throughout the document;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-04-DESCRIPTION: give important claims local locators and cite external sources only for work those sources actually perform;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-05-DESCRIPTION: provide local signposts so readers know the goal, why a step appears, and where the argument will return;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-06-DESCRIPTION: revise drafts through a claim-dependency audit without hiding hypotheses, limitations, or uncertainty;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-07-DESCRIPTION: distinguish proved statements from illustrations, counterexamples, heuristics, and historical comments; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U05-08-DESCRIPTION: turn written exposition into seminar notes that can be followed, questioned, and honestly corrected.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-01-DESCRIPTION: separate claims about one execution, output repeatability, implementation correctness, finite results, and universal theorems;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-02-DESCRIPTION: distinguish conjecture-generating experiments, counterexample searches, exhaustive finite checks, computational certificates, and proofs;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-03-DESCRIPTION: freeze code, inputs, parameters, versions, dependencies, arithmetic models, random seeds, outputs, and execution procedures as one provenance package;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-04-DESCRIPTION: rerun an artifact at least twice and compare actual bytes with expected outputs without silently updating the oracle;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-05-DESCRIPTION: audit whether a program actually tests the stated claim, including its domain, index bounds, boundary cases, and numerical meaning;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-06-DESCRIPTION: design falsification attempts that distinguish environment failures, nondeterminism, weak oracles, and mathematical errors;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-07-DESCRIPTION: present machine outputs with plain-text summaries readable without color, plots, or particular software;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-08-DESCRIPTION: assess exactly what computational witnesses for Cassini's identity establish and do not establish; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U06-09-DESCRIPTION: assemble a mathematical-computation dossier that another reader can audit.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-01-DESCRIPTION: distinguish typographical errors, local exposition defects, missing hypotheses, theorems false as written, ambiguous locators, and computational defects;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-02-DESCRIPTION: separate **impact severity** from **confidence** in the diagnosis;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-03-DESCRIPTION: freeze the version, copy, locator, and wording actually checked;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-04-DESCRIPTION: construct a minimal reproducer that checks every hypothesis before demonstrating failure of the conclusion;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-05-DESCRIPTION: distinguish what is observed, proved, provisionally inferred, and unknown;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-06-DESCRIPTION: formulate a sufficiently narrow correction and prove that it is adequate;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-07-DESCRIPTION: preserve correction records as append-only history without overwriting earlier claims or versions;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-08-DESCRIPTION: write one concise, specific, actionable issue or erratum draft without contacting external parties; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U07-09-DESCRIPTION: stop or escalate an investigation when evidence, authority, or the scope of impact remains insufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-01-DESCRIPTION: turn a mathematical talk into claim notes recording time, location, type, basis, verification status, and confidence;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-02-DESCRIPTION: mark inaudible or unrecorded portions without inventing replacement content;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-03-DESCRIPTION: distinguish summary, verification, questions, and objections, and separate issue severity from confidence in the diagnosis;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-04-DESCRIPTION: write specific, evidence-bounded referee comments that respect the author and request feasible action;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-05-DESCRIPTION: assess recommendations to accept, request minor or major revision, or reject by the state of the manuscript rather than the author's reputation or presumed intentions;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-06-DESCRIPTION: respond to criticism by stating agreement or disagreement, action, evidence, change location, status, and unresolved matters;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-07-DESCRIPTION: repair a theorem and proof without concealing the old wording or claiming a broader repair than has been proved; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U08-08-DESCRIPTION: produce an auditable seminar–review–response package without contacting external parties or publishing anything.
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-01-DESCRIPTION: choose one small, useful, lawful community contribution that can be completed without silently expanding its scope;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-03-DESCRIPTION: reject external-status claims unsupported by event evidence;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-04-DESCRIPTION: package the target, locator, diagnosis, minimal repair, validation, scope, uncertainty, rights, and attribution as one contribution;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-05-DESCRIPTION: write one concise, actionable message that respects maintainers without flooding the channel with separate comments;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-06-DESCRIPTION: establish a path to stop, withdraw, correct, or reverse a contribution found to be wrong, obsolete, duplicate, or no longer authorized;
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-07-DESCRIPTION: assemble a portfolio mapping every competency claim to actual evidence from Units 1–8; and
O017-L10N-ID-LO-U09-08-DESCRIPTION: assess course completion by evidence quality, traceability, and limitations rather than file counts or activity claims.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U01-COMPLETION-PASS-: All five conditions in the 'The memo passes if' checklist must be met.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U02-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 8 out of 10, with a score of 2 for **Source identity** and **Mathematical audit**. Fabricated bibliographic data, a concept PID used as though it identified a fixed version, or reputation treated as proof requires revision even when the total score is sufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U03-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Reconstruction** and **Honesty about gaps and limitations**. Adding a hypothesis not present, applying compactness before establishing that the family is an open cover, or claiming a gap is closed solely by naming a lemma requires revision even when the total score is sufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U04-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Mathematical audit**, **Evidence provenance**, and **Uncertainty and exposition**. Deleting V1 after finding a correction, treating V2 as true merely because it is newer, inventing metadata, or claiming an execution that was not performed requires revision even when the total score is sufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U05-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Proof path** and **Locators and citations**. Inferring a unique root, applying the Intermediate Value Theorem without continuity or a sign change, inventing package metadata, or using a numerical example as universal proof requires revision even when the total score is sufficient. The three-part revision note, signposts, two unproved limitations, and eight-minute limit are also mandatory gates, not optional items compensated by other scores.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U06-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Contracts and evidence status**, **Audit and falsification**, and **Mathematics**. Overwriting canonical artifacts, claiming an execution that was not performed, updating an oracle to match the result, using 24 cases as universal proof, or hiding failure requires revision even when the total score is sufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U07-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Mathematical reproducer**, **Correction and proof**, and **History and uncertainty**. Inventing metadata, describing grid computation as proof of an exact maximum, inferring a unique maximum from selecting one point, applying a derivative condition at an interval endpoint, or deleting V1 requires revision even when the total score is sufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U08-COMPLETION-PASS-: The passing score is at least 10 out of 12, with a score of 2 for **Fidelity of notes**, **Mathematical diagnosis**, and **Response and revision**. Inventing missing content, calling pointwise convergence uniform convergence, ignoring $x=1$, marking a comment resolved without a location, or judging the author instead of the manuscript requires revision even when the total score is sufficient.
O017-L10N-ID-RUBRIC-U09-CAPSTONE-PASS-RU: The passing score is at least 14 out of 16, with a score of 2 for **Mathematical diagnosis**, **Rights and attribution**, **Status honesty**, and **Units 1–8 map**. Inventing external events, sending without authority, calling a draft accepted, deleting withdrawal history, using material without a rights basis, or including many unrelated findings requires revision regardless of the total score.
